{{Quote|Life is all we have, girl. Do you think I'm about to let you take it away from me? I plan to live forever or&mdash;''"<br />"''Or die trying. Yes, very droll.|Stanton Rendar and Jaina Solo|<ref name="ODT" />}}
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] '''infiltrated''' the [[Onadax Droid Technologies headquarters|headquarters]] of [[Onadax Droid Technologies]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]]. The company has manufactured a [[Human replica droid]] that betrayed the citizens of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], and Solo hopes to bring them to justice for the crimes that their clients commit. After sneaking past several [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] security guards, she confronted [[Stanton Rendar (droid)|Stanton Rendar]], but he loosed several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on her which gave Stanton time to escape.
